item.title: Support for the data management plans of the ArcticNet research program
item.description: The ArcticNet research program is a Canadian network of over 230 researchers studying the Arctic’s human health, natural sciences, and social sciences. We supported principal investigators with adopting best practices in terms of data management by reviewing their data management plan in light of the FAIR Principles.

item.title: Support for the management of ecosystem monitoring data from Bylot Island
item.description: After 30 years of data collection on Bylot Island, researchers have generated more than 20 databases used for long-term ecosystem monitoring. Throughout this project, we analyzed the specific challenges linked to these databases and we proposed concrete solutions to improve data management practices.
